# Overview of MicroDuck Task Demonstration

Here, it is presented according to tasks. GPU inference occurs first, followed by BPU inference. Click on the expanded item to view more versions; for training, model sources, and implementation steps, please refer to the task tutorials.

The GPU performs calculations on the workstation; the BPU performs calculations on the RDK X5, while the workstation is responsible for simulation and rendering. The web page displays saved task videos; to rerun steps, refer to [ Notebook explanation ](../../03-Notebook/README.md).

## Materials and Reproduction

- All submitted video previews are in GIF format; the first 7 Notebooks display videos using relative GIF links, while the 8th one retains small-sized images and trajectory plots. After execution, navigation MP4 files are played within the unit.
- The original MP4 files remain on the simulation workstation to reduce cloning and browsing overhead. The environment, model, metrics, and reproduction steps for each task are provided in the corresponding task README.
- Running the Notebooks generates new task MP4 files and evaluation reports.
